name: Cupid's Crawl - Singles Mixer
description:
4 bars, 1 Friday night and 20 singles making their way through all of them.  
A cocktail and an appetiser at every stop, ice breakers along the way, and a
host to keep the night moving.  
  
Friday, 20 November, 7 PM | Only 20 spots.  
**__Please note: This specific mixer is for individuals aged between 28-35
only.__**
